name: Macnica Galaxy Inc.
summary: Macnica Galaxy Inc., together with its subisidaries, engages in the agency trading and technical service of semiconductor electronic components in Taiwan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company distributes semiconductors, AI, IoT, CAE simulation software, AI-powered commercial service robots, and industrial-grade robotic arms. It also exports and imports electronic and electrical components, as well as finished products. The company serves the server, IoT, communication, industrial electronics, automotive, and smart factory sectors. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan. Macnica Galaxy Inc. is a subsidiary of Macnica Chungju Co., Ltd.
